name: ch20_helheim01_rune_symbols
chapter: 20 Yggdrasil: the rune symbol on the entrance's frame (docs/matrix/20_yggdrasil.md C20-02, C20-08)
note: l7_helheim01 from checkpoint 8939 on the entry ledge. Rune symbol 8995 (ar_uo_rune_wall_switch_d) is on the west pillar of the door frame, in the alcove beside it: Interact in front of it uses it and its script reports to dispatcher 8997, which counts the four symbols [O bytecode: vt 63-66 set a flag each, vt 62 stops eitr fall 8998 (vt 56) for the 60 s of its clock once all four are set]. One symbol alone leaves the fall running.

expect.note: one of four: the eitr fall runs on
